plan.notes: Source: Bronx Community College official "Business Administration (A.S. Degree) Accounting Option" degree map PDF (dated 5/24/22, Fall 2022) - filed as 2022-2023, disclosed here. The document states it is "for advisement purposes only and does not represent an official listing of degree requirements; please consult the college catalog and DegreeWorks" - disclosed here; transcribed exactly as published. Transcribed: 15+14+17+15 = 61 ("TOTAL: 60-61"; 60 applies to transfer students exempt from FYS 11 per footnote 6 - disclosed here). FYS 11 transcribed at 1 credit (see slot note), consistent with the existing BCC Computer Programming plan. Footnote 2 (math placement): MTH 1/5/6 no longer offered; CUNY-math-proficient STEM students enroll in MTH 28.5; transfer to senior colleges requires MTH 28/28.5 in Required Core B and MTH 30 in Flexible Core E. Footnote 4 flex-core guidance documented in slot notes. Footnote 5 science/lab rule documented in slot notes. Transfer note: students targeting Lehman, SUNY Maritime, SUNY Potsdam, or Baruch should check BCC Transfer Services articulation agreements. Prerequisites recorded only for the ACC 111->112->113 chain.

courses.title: English Composition I (Required Core A)
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "ENG 100 OR ENG 110 OR ENG 111 English Composition I (Required Core A)" (3 credits). Footnote 1: ENG 100 for EPI 0-49, ENG 110 for EPI 50-64, ENG 111 for EPI 65+.

courses.title: College Algebra and Elementary Trigonometry (Required Core B)
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "MTH 28 OR MTH 28.5 College Algebra and Elementary Trigonometry OR Corequisite (Required Core B)" (3 credits). Footnote 2 documented in plan notes.

courses.title: First Year Seminar
courses.choice_note: Plan prints "FYS 11 (0-1)". Footnote 3: students must take FYS 11 before earning 24 credits; waived for students with 24+ transfer credits (who graduate with 60). Transcribed at 1 credit for first-time freshmen (the map's 15-credit subtotal assumes it), consistent with the existing BCC Computer Programming plan - disclosed here.

courses.title: English Composition II (Required Core A)
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "ENG 112 OR ENG 113 OR ENG 114 OR ENG 115 OR ENG 116 English Composition II (Required Core A)" (3 credits).

courses.title: Life and Physical Science (Required Core C)
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "Life and Physical Science (Required Core C)" (3-4 credits). Options: AST 111 General Astronomy; BIO 11 General Biology I; CHM 111 General Chemistry I; CHM 17 Fundamentals of General Chemistry I; ENV 11 Introduction to Environmental Science; ESE 11 Earth Systems Science I; ESE 12 Earth Systems Science II; ESE 13 Earth Systems Science III; PHY 110 Engineering Physics I; PHY 11 College Physics I. Footnote 5: students may select a 4-credit or 3-credit science; a 3-credit selection requires an additional 1-credit lab course. Transcribed at 4 credits with the lab at 0 (subtotal 17 either way) - disclosed here.

courses.title: Lab Science Course
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "LAB - Lab Science Course (0-1)". Footnote 5: required (1 credit) only if a 3-credit science is selected above. Transcribed at 0 with the science at 4 credits - disclosed here.
